when: Save typed layout and rich choice bodies, then publish an approved locale overlay with changed visual order.
then: Each locale retains exact control position and identities. The candidate projection contains no grading rules or hidden solution.

scenarios.title: On-demand hint uses exact visible rule order and preserves private solution
given: An active learner has two allowed hints and a withheld model solution.
when: Request first hint, replay same key, then request with expected count one. Try the same command after close.
then: Exactly two durable hint uses exist and both expose only the selected body. Replay creates no duplicate. The model solution remains withheld.

scenarios.title: Zero contribution preserves raw learner marks without grade evidence
given: A synthetic four-point item has explicit zero contribution with none grade mode and accessible feedback.
when: Seal an attempt and accept three raw points.
then: The accepted raw mark remains 3 of 4. No GradeEvidence is written. No counting denominator changes.

scenarios.title: Decision-count rewards omitted distractors and guards explicit blank
given: A six-choice synthetic compatibility rule has accepted keys A and B, one point and declared decision-count mode.
when: Score selections A and C, the complete accepted set and an explicit empty set.
then: Apply one response-level two-decimal midpoint-away rounding. Return 0.67, 1 and 0 respectively under the verified empty guard.

scenarios.title: Required written and file channels cannot be silently sealed as blank
given: A synthetic constructed response requires both a written answer and an approved file.
when: Submit valid text with pending file, then let the deadline arrive before the scan finishes.
then: Finalization returns REQUIRED_RESPONSE_MISSING. Expiry preserves drafts and produces no successful sealed manifest.

scenarios.title: Comment-only rubric can complete required staff workflow at zero maximum
given: The only synthetic rubric criterion has one optional zero level and a required reviewer comment. Self review is enabled and staff bypass is explicitly approved.
when: Publish the rubric. Reject an empty required comment. Accept authorized comment and an independently approved bypass decision.
then: Feedback-only maximum stays zero. The mark and bypass are auditable and no earned numeric evidence is fabricated.

scenarios.title: Scored submission wait preserves draft access and retry form identity
given: An eligible learner submitted the first attempt at 09:00. A thirty-second wait and retain-first-form policy apply.
when: The learner starts a separate attempt at 09:00:10, saves a draft, tries submitting at 09:00:20 and retries with a fresh command key at 09:00:30.
then: The new attempt has independent response evidence and the same compatible realized option order.
Draft saving succeeds during the wait. The early scored submission is rejected, while the submission at the inclusive boundary is admitted.
